propositions: Phase 1 skipped 836 unmarked truncated comments across three Jira issues (REB-1567, REB-1931, REB-2605) because they lacked the reconciler marker that enables authoritative identification
Truncated comments are identifiable by the reconciler's own truncation suffix and the absence of the reconciler marker, caused by truncation cutting the marker off after the body is appended
Deletion must preserve the oldest copy per distinct normalized body and verify zero data loss of distinct bodies and parity of non-candidate counts before and after

The recorded comment_ids map is currently empty, so phase 2's oldest-keep rule is safe, but the final sweep after bridge re-enablement must invert to keep the newest (id-referenced) copy instead to avoid orphaning recorded ids
Operator must execute phase 2 cleanup, then re-enable the bridge, then perform a final sweep accounting for the first pass re-posts using the inverted keep-rule
